youtube.title: DRS SARAH AND RANDALL FARRANT
youtube.summary: Rodney and doctors Sarah and Randall Farrant discuss the vital role of gut health in overall wellbeing, highlighting its influence on the brain, immunity, and long-term health. They examine how birth methods, diet, and antibiotics shape the gut microbiome, especially in children. They also emphasise natural support through fibre-rich and fermented foods, proper hydration, and good digestion, alongside supportive practices to maintain a healthy gut. youtube.title: IAIN DAVIS
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan speaks with UK investigative journalist Iain Davis about his new book The Technocratic Dark State , in which he lays out the evidence that a network of Silicon Valley elites is advancing a post-democratic, technocratic model of governance via the second Trump Administration. Davis links the “Dark Enlightenment” philosophy to figures such as Peter Thiel and Elon Musk, warning of corporate-run ‘sovereign realms' where citizens become customers and rights are tokenised on digital ledgers. He cautions that AI-driven governance, digital ID, and special economic zones are early signs of a system that could erode liberties unless actively resisted. Please note this interview was recorded before the UK arrest of Peter Mandelson and contain references to him not having being arrested. Discover more from Iain on his website , substack and X

youtube.title: HRVOJE MORIC
youtube.summary: Independent journalist and podcaster Hrvoje Morić joins Paul for a discussion about the moves that are reshaping the globe in to a series of Technates – regional power blocs – that he believes will ultimately operate under one global government driven by surveillance and algocracy (rule by algorithm). Morić believes ‘the hour is late', with much of the architecture needed to do this already in place. He says a focus on local connections and parallel structures is the best defence against the advancing new world order. For more information visit Hrvoje's website Geopolitics and Empire or find him on X

youtube.title: CLAIRE BLEAKLEY
youtube.summary: In January the Food Standards Australia New Zealand (FSANZ) approved the GM Purple tomato, engineered with genes from the snapdragon, into the food chain as a fresh tomato. The Office of the Gene Regulator (OGTR) approved the seeds for growing and marketing, in Australia. GE Free NZ director Claire Bleakley points out that the GM fruit has no history of safe use as there was an absence of nutritional studies to see if allergens or hidden health problems might occur over time. Approval for the release of a living viable GM would need to have approval from the EPANZ before it could be imported and sold in New Zealand. Claire also talks about a Brand New Zealand survey of cruise-ship visitors that shows strong opposition to New Zealand relaxing its rules on GMO crops and animals. For more information: GE Free NZ: Supermarkets need EPA approval to import GMO Purple Tomato into NZ GE Free NZ: International Visitors Say No to GMO Release In New Zealand – Survey

youtube.title: NICOLAS HULSCHER
